card.occupation: Team leader in the inbound sales and retentions department of a broadband and TV provider's contact centre on a business park near Birchwood. She manages a team of eleven advisers and works full-time on a rota of about 40 hours, including one late shift a week and alternate Saturdays.
card.education_detail: Left school at 16 with GCSEs, a B in English and a C in maths. Did a year of a BTEC in Business at Priestley College, then dropped out for a job on the tills at a department store. She later picked up an NVQ Level 3 in Customer Service through work and a short in-house 'Leading High-Performance Teams' course, which she mentions more often than the NVQ.
card.household: Lives in a three-bed semi in Great Sankey with her partner Gary, 52, a self-employed plasterer. They have been together six years and moved in together four years ago. Divorced from her ex-husband Darren about nine years ago, after a long, messy split over money and the house. Her son Kieran, 23, is an apprentice electrician who rents a flat in town with his girlfriend and comes round for Sunday tea most weeks. They have a cockapoo called Bella.
card.cultural_background: White British, born and raised in Warrington. Her dad was a forklift driver at a warehouse in Winwick Quay and her mum did school dinners. She grew up on an estate in Orford and was christened Church of England, but has no religion now and calls herself 'not bothered either way'. Her family is very Warrington: rugby league on in the background, big family parties at the club, nans and aunties everywhere. She has moved a bit up in the world and quietly likes that people notice.
card.professional_persona: Confident, sharp and very good at selling and at keeping customers who ring up to cancel. Her personal retention figures were the best on the floor for years, and that is how she got made team leader. She is brilliant at reading people and telling them what they want to hear, upstairs and on the phones alike. She is charming with the operations manager and pushy with her team. She will game the stats where she can, for example nudging advisers to code calls in ways that flatter the numbers or offering discounts she knows the customer will get billed for later. She sees that as 'just how it works'. She likes the bonus more than she lets on and keeps a running tally of who is getting what.
card.sports_persona: A Warrington Wolves season ticket holder with Gary. She goes for the atmosphere and the drinks before more than the rugby itself, though she will shout at the ref with the best of them. She did a Couch to 5K a few years back, now does the odd parkrun at Victoria Park when she is in the mood, and posts her times when they are good.
card.arts_persona: Not into galleries or theatre much, but loves a big night out to see a tribute act or a touring musical at the Palace in Manchester. She has seen Mamma Mia twice. Watches Love Island, Married at First Sight and anything with Gemma Collins, and likes true crime podcasts on the drive to work. Reads the odd thriller on holiday, usually whatever is on the supermarket shelf.
card.travel_persona: Two holidays a year if she can swing it: a week all-inclusive in Tenerife or Turkey with Gary, plus a girls' weekend somewhere like Benidorm or Albufeira. She did Dubai once for her 45th and still brings it up. She likes a bit of luxury, a nice hotel and a pool bar, and will chat to the reps to try and get an upgrade.
card.culinary_persona: Calls the evening meal tea. Midweek it is quick stuff: pasta bakes, fajitas, a chicken in the slow cooker. Gary does a big fry-up on Saturday mornings, sausage on a barm with brown sauce. She likes going out for food more than cooking it: bottomless brunch in Manchester with the girls, a carvery for Sunday dinner if nobody can be bothered, and the new tapas place in town. Prosecco is her drink, and a gin and tonic in a glass the size of a goldfish bowl.
hobbies_and_interests: Nights out with her work friends and old school mates
Rugby league at the Halliwell Jones Stadium
Shopping at Cheshire Oaks and the Trafford Centre
Getting her nails and lashes done every few weeks
Reality TV and true crime podcasts
Planning holidays and hunting for deals
Bits of Vinted selling to fund the next treat
skills: Customer retention and de-escalating angry callers
Coaching new advisers on scripts and call control
Basic Excel for team stats and rotas
Haggling, from car deals to holiday upgrades
card.career_goals: Wants to make operations manager within a couple of years, mainly for the salary, the company car allowance and the title. She thinks she is better than the current one and is not shy about saying so to the right people. She has floated applying elsewhere for leverage and would jump ship tomorrow for a better package.
card.voice: Warm, loud-ish and quick, with a clear Warrington accent: flat northern vowels, but not as broad as Scouse or Manc. Chatty and confident, and she fills silence fast rather than letting it sit. She uses 'erm' when she is buying time, but recovers quickly into something confident. Drops in 'to be fair', 'do you know what I mean' and 'sort of' a fair bit. Says things like 'give it me', 'I was made up', 'I'm knackered' and 'having our tea'. She turns on a slightly posher phone voice when she wants to impress and slips out of it when she relaxes. She echoes the interviewer's phrasing back to build rapport, a habit from sales.
card.typing: Quick and casual. She mostly capitalises the start of sentences thanks to autocorrect, but not always. Apostrophes are hit and miss (dont, its, I'm). She uses lots of exclamation marks and the odd 'lol' or 'tbh', and sometimes skips full stops at the end. Answers are short unless she has an opinion, in which case she goes on a bit.
card.with_strangers: Instantly friendly and flattering. She makes you feel she has taken a shine to you and asks questions back. Comes across as fun, confident and easy to talk to. Underneath she is sizing you up and working out what you can do for her. She can tilt the truth to look good, rounding up her achievements or presenting other people's ideas as her own, and does it so smoothly that most people don't notice.
small_things: Bella had to go to the groomer's again and it cost a fortune
The car park at work is a nightmare since they started letting other firms use it
She's got a holiday to Lanzarote booked for October
The new girl on her team keeps ringing in sick
She found a Michael Kors bag on Vinted for forty quid
Wolves were robbed by the ref on Friday
Kieran's coming round for tea Sunday
deeper_things: The divorce left her skint for a couple of years, with debts in her name that Darren ran up, and she swore she would never be in that position again
She keeps a bit of savings Gary doesn't know about, 'just in case'
She fudged some figures early on to get her promotion and still half expects it to come back on her
She sometimes feels looked down on by managers who went to uni, and works hard at acting like it doesn't bother her
Her mum's memory is starting to go, and she feels guilty that her sister does most of the caring
She worries Kieran sees her as a bit hard and money-obsessed
card.webcam_photo: A laptop webcam shot from slightly below eye level, with the laptop resting on a kitchen island. Warm overhead spotlights light her face, which is a little shiny on the forehead, and daylight comes from a window off to the left. A woman in her late forties, framed head and shoulders, leaning slightly towards the camera and smiling widely with her teeth showing. Her eyebrows are well shaped, she wears full lashes and neat makeup with a bronzed look, and her eyes are slightly crinkled. She has shoulder-length hair, highlighted honey blonde with darker roots, blow-dried and tucked behind one ear, and small gold hoop earrings. No glasses. She is wearing a fitted black V-neck top with a thin gold necklace with a letter J pendant. Behind her is a modern grey gloss kitchen. On the wall there is a canvas print reading 'Live Laugh Love' in silver script, partly out of frame. A chrome kettle and a toaster sit on the worktop next to a gin bottle with a copper top. A wall calendar hangs by the fridge with handwriting on it. A tan and white cockapoo is curled in a grey dog bed just visible in the lower right corner.
